wiki.title: John Alcala
wiki.extract: John Alcala (May 23, 1959) is an American politician currently serving as a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives, representing the 57th district (Topeka, Kansas in Shawnee County, Kansas). He is a graduate of both Topeka High School and Washburn University. For 14 years he was a member of the Topeka City Council after which he became city's Deputy Mayor.
